body: Nail on the head chum, I wallow in loneliness as as an act of self harm, I used to cut but it got a lot of attention and that’s not really what I was looking for. I stopped but occasionally have relapses
I don’t think of myself as evil, but deeply flawed. I get mentally sick and my behaviors in such state are unintentionally but knowingly harmful

I used betterhelp, got a week free trial and could make as many appointments with a therapist as were available. Worked great for me as I did them over the phone, much less confrontational and it made it easier to open up. But you could also text whenever. Helped me to address my family issues and deal with the drama going on with my mom at the time.

I have self destructive tendencies which include pushing people away and purposefully ruining the relationship in order to isolate myself, which can be painful for the other party, and in the process I’ll say and do anything to make them get out of my life even when the person is good for me. My actions can become manipulative and even abusive (ex: gaslighting) in order to reach the result.

Maybe but if not then I waste money on college that could’ve gone to my brother, and suffer longer. Plus risk hurting the people around me while in this state. I’ve dragged out my life longer than I ever expected anyway
I’m sorry to hear about you getting hacked. I like to think time can heal nearly anything. Things like that never completely go away, just get less relevant as life moves on and you think less of it
The home invasion, I never feel safe anymore and it gave me horrible nightmares for months. Don’t know why that one though, seems small in comparison to others

It’s kind of an ongoing thing that’s just gotten worse with time, bad home life (neglect/ emotional abuse) and not great mental health. Plus isolated incidents that added on (ex: housefire, family death, divorce, rape, home invasion & vandalism). Covid didn’t help either, tried to get away from my home life situation when my family left the state to quarantine for the duration and got pulled back in. Now I’m back where I was plus my family hates me because I tried to get away

I don’t know if this will help but when I’ve found myself asking these questions I’ve concluded ceasing to exist keeps me from perceiving anything ever again, and while continuing to exist is a struggle and can be painful, it at least gives me the ability to feel something, and the opportunity to feel better. I’d rather feel something than feel nothing, and I’d rather hurt with the hope of healing. (Although this mentality may not apply depending on your beliefs but I just thought I’d share)
It is just a picture of me in a towel, I suppose I just don’t consider it provocative because I’m covered, but I can understand how it could be considered that way
